description_en: Prefetches URLs to warm the cache
kebab_example: aliyun esa preload-caches --site-id 1234567890000 --content http://a.com/1.jpg0b=1 --headers key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: PreloadCaches

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The default header carried in a prefetch request is Accept-Encoding:gzip. If you want the prefetch request to carry other headers or implement multi-copy prefetching, use this parameter to customize the prefetch headers
parameters.help_zh: 预热请求默认携带的header是Accept-Encoding:gzip，如果您需要预热请求携带其他header，或者实现多副本预热，那么可以使用该参数来实现自定义预热header
parameters.name: headers
